preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 30.
For each test case, n must be between 1 and 30000, c must be between 1 and 4, and q must be between 1 and 300000.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n and all(1 <= p_i <= n for p_i in p) and len(set(p)) == n
preconditions.description: The permutation p must have length n, contain integers from 1 to n, and all elements must be unique.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= 10**18 for i, j in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must have valid indices i and j within the specified ranges.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if j > len(permutations) else stdout == str(permutations[j-1][i-1])
postconditions.description: For each query, output the i-th number in the j-th permutation or -1 if the permutation does not exist.
